title: 第5章 赵匡胤第6章 返回家中
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
赵大赵二冷漠的走向了叶辰，叶辰冷静的思考着，硬拼现在根本不是二人的对手，神魂攻击目前很无法使用，唯一的出路就是比拼能量。
虽然境界低，但体内的能量却远远的高于三人，靠着身法游走，慢慢耗死三人，
赵大赵二原以为能迅速的结束战斗，不曾想叶辰身法迅捷，几百招下来就没伤到一丝一毫，自己二人多处流血，而且叶辰体力，身法没有一点的减弱，一个小小的淬体境三重天就有如此连绵不绝的能量，真是小看了这少年。
“赵二，这小子有点诡异，我们全力以赴”
“大哥，放心”赵二回道，他腾空而起，在空中旋身，轰出一拳，拳风呼啸而至，叶辰大惊，一招有凤来仪，随后游龙戏凤，追风步左转腾挪，化解了拳风，随后一跃而起，逍遥剑法十三式，一一展现出来，赵大赵二进不得半分
赵匡胤怒骂道“两个废物，几个时辰了连个淬体境三重天的都解决不了”
“少爷，这小子有点诡异，能量一点也没有消耗”赵大委屈道
叶辰不断的磨炼剑法，生死搏斗，终于突破到人剑合一之境。
眼到心到手到剑到，剑法更加犀利，先解决掉一个，全力攻击赵大，剑法之快，赵大眼忙手乱，赵二见势不妙，急忙转到赵大身旁，关心则乱，一边观察赵大伤势一边帮忙抵挡叶辰的剑招。
叶辰则故意加大力度攻击赵大，眼观六路耳听八方，趁赵二分心照顾赵大，一招狂龙幻影输出后，使用疾风穿云一剑劈飞赵二的头颅。
“赵二”赵大大喊到，“小子你竟然敢杀我兄弟，今日你必死于我刀下”
赵匡胤也急了，“真是废物，两个淬体境九重天竟然让一个淬体境三重天的杀了一个。”赵匡胤手持霸王枪也加入了搏斗中
“少爷，小心，这小子剑法出神入化，已经到了人剑合一之境，稍有不慎，就会有危险”，赵大担心道
叶辰，现在也开始有点吃力，取出一颗回气丹扔到嘴里，赵大现在能量十不存一，靠着境界高，力气大，还能给叶辰带来压力，赵匡胤眼高手低，实战经验不足，还是先解决赵匡胤吧！
三人你来我往又斗了两个时辰，叶辰终于抓住机会，一剑刺中了赵匡胤。
“小子你敢杀我，我大哥一定会为我报仇，灭了你家族”赵匡胤不甘的怒喊出最后遗言。
“杀人者人恒杀之，哪有只能是你杀我的道理”。叶辰讪讪的说道。
赵大慌了，得尽快逃走，叶辰自不会让他逃走，将紫霄剑掷出去，刚好刺入赵大后背穿胸而过。
叶辰收起赤炎虎和嗜血狂狮，开始打扫战场，赵大赵二用的是两把黄级下品大刀，赵匡胤是一柄霸王枪，属于黄级上品兵器，
腰间挂着储物袋，只有一丈大小，金币有一万多，几株灵药，金银花，地龙草，回气丹五瓶，引气丹一瓶，另外还有一块庚金石，可以炼制玄器的材料，还算不错，全部转移到储物戒中。

叶辰打扫完战场，经过长达六个时辰的生死搏斗，现在也累的不行了，找个山洞休息一下，用精神力探查周围环境，一般情况下到了金丹境才能修炼出精神力，叶辰现在的精神力堪比金丹境，方圆十丈之内都尽收脑中
咦，这有个山洞，怎么这么隐蔽，如果不是精神力根本发现不了这个山洞，进入洞口，点燃火把，四处观察了一下。
竟有一株灵药，玉髓芝，这是三品灵药，炼制筑基丹的主药，妖兽吃了也可以晋升三级，刚刚成熟，管不的赤炎虎和嗜血狂狮在附近搏斗，原来是闻到了药香！这下便宜了我，玉髓芝一般三十年成熟，十年生长，十年开花，十年成熟。
走，到里面看看，看还有有什么宝贝吗，弯弯绕绕的走了一个时辰，到了洞底，一堆兽骨，估计死了有上千年，一滩灵乳，大概有一丈多，这可是很东西，估计是千年灵乳，边上还有一株天元果树，一颗天元果可以增寿百年，百年开花，百年结果，百年成熟，一次可以结果10颗，叶辰将天元果摘下来，先放到储物戒中。
content_en:
Zhao Da and Zhao Er walked towards Ye Chen indifferently. Ye Chen thought calmly. They are no match for them in a head-on fight. The soul attack is currently unusable. The only way out is to compete in energy.
Although the realm is low, the energy in the body is far higher than that of the three people. He relies on his body skills to move around, slowly consuming the three people to death.
Zhao Da and Zhao Er originally thought that the battle could be ended quickly, but they never thought that Ye Chen's body skills were so fast that he could do hundreds of moves without any injuries. The two of them were bleeding in many places, and Ye Chen's physical strength and body skills had not weakened at all. A small person in the third level of the Body Tempering Realm had such continuous energy. He really underestimated this young man.
"Zhao Er, this guy is a little weird, let's go all out."
"Brother, don't worry," Zhao Er replied. He rose into the air, spun around in the air, and punched out. The wind of the fist roared towards him. Ye Chen was shocked. A phoenix came with each move. Then he played with the dragon and played with the phoenix. He turned left to chase the wind and diffused the wind. Then he jumped up and displayed the thirteen moves of Xiaoyao Sword Technique one by one. Zhao Da and Zhao Er couldn't get even half a point forward.
Zhao Kuangyin cursed angrily, "Two trash, they can't even deal with someone from the third level of the Body Tempering Realm after a few hours."
"Master, this kid is a bit weird, and his energy is not consumed at all," Zhao Da said aggrievedly.
Ye Chen continued to hone his sword skills, fought life and death, and finally broke through to the point where man and sword become one.
Eyes to heart to hand to sword, the swordsmanship is sharper. He kills one first and attacks Zhao Da with all his strength. The swordsmanship is so fast that Zhao Da's eyes are in a hurry and his hands are in a hurry. Zhao Er sees that the situation is not good and hurriedly turns to Zhao Da's side. Concern makes him confused. While observing Zhao Da's injuries, he helps to resist Ye Chen's sword moves.
Ye Chen deliberately increased the intensity of his attack on Zhao Da, watching all directions and listening in all directions. While Zhao Er was distracted to take care of Zhao Da, after outputting the phantom of the mad dragon, he used the Wind Piercing Cloud sword to chop off Zhao Er's head.
"Zhao Er," Zhao Da shouted, "boy, you dare to kill my brother, you will die by my sword today."
Zhao Kuangyin was also anxious, "What a waste. Two people from the ninth level of the Body Tempering Realm actually let one from the third level of the Body Tempering Realm kill one." Zhao Kuangyin also joined the fight holding the Overlord Spear.
"Young master, be careful. This boy's swordsmanship is superb. He has reached the point where the sword and man are united. If you are not careful, you will be in danger," Zhao Da said worriedly.
Ye Chen, now starting to have some difficulty, took out a Qi Recovery Pill and threw it into his mouth. Zhao Da now has very little energy. With his high realm and strong strength, he can also bring pressure to Ye Chen. Zhao Kuangyin has a good eye but a weak hand, and lacks actual combat experience. Let's deal with Zhao Kuangyin first!
The three of them fought back and forth for another two hours. Ye Chen finally seized the opportunity and stabbed Zhao Kuangyin with his sword.
"Boy, if you dare to kill me, my elder brother will definitely avenge me and destroy your family." Zhao Kuangyin shouted his last words angrily and unwillingly.
"Those who kill will always be killed. There is no reason why you can only kill me." Ye Chen said sarcastically.
Zhao Da panicked and had to escape as soon as possible. Ye Chen would not let him escape, so he threw the Zixiao Sword, which happened to penetrate Zhao Da's back and pass through his chest.
Ye Chen put away the Red Flame Tiger and the Bloodthirsty Lion and began to clean the battlefield. Zhao Da and Zhao Er used two low-grade yellow-level swords, and Zhao Kuangyin used an Overlord Spear, which is a high-grade yellow-level weapon.
There is a storage bag hanging on the waist, only one foot in size, with more than 10,000 gold coins, several elixirs, honeysuckle, earth dragon grass, five bottles of Qi-returning pills, one bottle of Qi-inducing pills, and a Geng gold stone, which is a good material for refining mysterious weapons. They are all transferred to the storage ring.
Ye Chen finished cleaning the battlefield. After six hours of life-and-death struggle, he was now exhausted. He found a cave to rest and used his mental power to explore the surrounding environment. Normally, mental power can only be cultivated in the Golden Core Realm. Ye Chen's current mental power is comparable to that of the Golden Core Realm. He can capture everything within a ten-foot radius in his mind.
Hey, there is a cave here. Why is it so hidden? If it weren't for my mental power, I wouldn't have been able to find this cave. I entered the cave entrance, lit the torch, and looked around.There is actually an elixir, chalcedony, which is a third-grade elixir. It is the main elixir for refining the foundation-building pill. Monsters can advance to the third level after eating it. It has just matured and the uncontrollable Red Flame Tiger and Bloodthirsty Lion are fighting nearby. It turns out that they smell the fragrance of the medicine! This is an advantage for me. Chalcedony mushrooms usually take thirty years to mature, ten years to grow, ten years to bloom, and ten years to mature.
Let's go and take a look inside to see if there are any treasures. After walking in a winding way for an hour, we arrived at the bottom of the cave. There was a pile of animal bones, which were estimated to have been dead for thousands of years.
